newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA sees $10 bln savings through restructuring.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA sees $10 bln savings through restructuring.

text.p: Venezuela's state owned Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) expects to generate $10 billion in savings over ten years through its major corporate restructuring due to start in August this year, PDVSA President Luis Giusti said.
"Over the next 10 years this (restructuring) could generate an income in present net terms of $10 billion," Giusti told reporters after making a presentation at an investors' forum.
Giusti confirmed that PDVSA had approved at the weekend a major restructuring of its business units to cut costs and improve efficiency.

Under the restructuring plan PDVSA's three main subsidiaries Corpoven, Lagoven and Maraven will be dissolved to create more focused business units. Each of the three affiliates currently duplicate functions as three vertically integrated companies.
